narrative:
Paulding County has 12,186 registered voters, with 13.6% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 34.5% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 47.7%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 13.3 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.2% of registrants.
